description: Water Supply Pumpset Assets is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Corporation. Layer containing pump sets owned by Melbourne Water and used for water supply. Includes pump station name, description, pump type and other key attributes. This layer is intended to be used to locate and obtain details on Melbourne Water's water supply transfer assets for asset management, buildover (Dial-Before-You-Dig) and operational / maintenance purposes. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Corporation. Its tags are melbourne water, pump, pumping stations, water supply. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2025-02-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
